evaluation.confirmation_rule: CONFIRMED iff QUALIFIED in development AND on the holdout

development_period.rule: rows with trading_date <= end; targets built inside this frame, so no holdout price is used

holdout_period.limitation: not pristine: Phase 3 / Phase 8 evaluated parts of it
holdout_period.name: Phase-9 confirmation holdout

evaluation.holdout_procedure: only frozen development qualifiers, each exactly once; labelled holdout rows in 20 contiguous folds, expanding-window training on all earlier rows minus a gap of `horizon` rows; same metrics and gate_v1
evaluation.row_selection: Phase 8 feature-store rows covered by every family, incl. sentiment_window_v1 (20-session window inside the news interval) and market_context_v1 (strict); identical rows for every feature set; targets rebuilt from Close by the harness
evaluation.tuning: none - every parameter fixed in this matrix

market_context_v1.aapl_minus_spy_return_k: (A[D] / A[D-k] - 1) - (S[D] / S[D-k] - 1), A = AAPL adjusted Close, k in (1, 5)
market_context_v1.alignment: SPY/QQQ sessions must equal AAPL sessions over the needed range; missing/extra -> error
market_context_v1.information_timestamp: bars dated <= D only; bar D complete at D 16:30 America/New_York = row_prediction_timestamp(D)
market_context_v1.lookback: k sessions back = k-th previous trading session of the same series
market_context_v1.qqq_return_k: Q[D] / Q[D-k] - 1, Q = QQQ adjusted Close, k in (1, 5)
market_context_v1.source: raw daily snapshots (yfinance, auto_adjust) verified by sha256
market_context_v1.spy_return_k: S[D] / S[D-k] - 1, S = SPY adjusted Close, k in (1, 5, 20)
market_context_v1.spy_volatility_20: sample std (ddof=1) of ln(S[j] / S[j-1]) for j = D-19 .. D

sentiment_window_v1.coverage: covered iff ts(prev_20(D)) >= news interval start and ts(D) <= news interval end; uncovered rows are NaN
sentiment_window_v1.information_timestamp: every input article has information_available_at <= ts(D)
sentiment_window_v1.sw_mean_k: mean of FinBERT sentiment_score (P(pos) - P(neg)) over W_k(D); 0.0 if empty; k in (1, 5, 20)
sentiment_window_v1.sw_negative_ratio_k: #negative-label articles in W_k / |W_k|; 0.0 if empty; k in (5, 20)
sentiment_window_v1.sw_positive_ratio_k: #positive-label articles in W_k / |W_k|; 0.0 if empty; k in (5, 20)
sentiment_window_v1.window: W_k(D) = articles with symbol in symbols and ts(prev_k(D)) < information_available_at <= ts(D); ts(D) = D 16:30 America/New_York; prev_k(D) = k-th trading session before D
